capabilities.definition: Ability to provide customers secure access to banking services through web-based platforms, enabling transactions, account management, and service requests anytime, anywhere.
Ability to deliver banking services through mobile applications, offering convenient access to accounts, payments, transfers, and personalized alerts on smartphones and tablets.
Ability to engage customers and prospects via social media platforms, supporting service inquiries, brand interactions, targeted campaigns, and feedback collection in real time.
Ability to enable digital interactions with corporate clients through dedicated platforms and APIs for seamless transactions and information exchange.
Ability to address customer queries and requests through call centers and automated voice systems for efficient service delivery.
Ability to provide in-person banking services at physical locations, supporting transactions, advisory, and relationship management.
Ability to offer self-service banking through ATMs, point-of-sale terminals, and kiosks for cash, payments, and account access.
Ability to deliver banking communication and services through postal mail, including statements, notices, and official correspondence.
Ability to identify, describe, and analyze the appropriate market need for a new or enhanced channel.
Ability to ideate and outline the vision, scope, and objectives of a new channel, aligning with business goals and customer expectations.
Ability to formalize a channel concept by defining its specifications and features.
Ability to create approximations of the channel in order to determine feasibility and / or applicability of the channel.
Ability to create mock-ups of the channel in order to determine feasibility and / or applicability of the channel.
Ability to finalize, document, and standardize channel solutions for deployment, scaling, and future enhancements.
Ability to define, interpret, and enforce the right to view, use, or modify a channel.
Ability to define, set, and monitor performance goals (KPIs, SLAs, adoption rates, transaction volumes) for delivery channels.
Ability to ascertain, discover and establish the financial effectiveness and viability of a channel.
Ability to measure brand visibility, customer adoption, and overall recognition of channels to evaluate market positioning and effectiveness.
Ability to manage channel risk by utilizing risk management capabilities and incorporating other related risks.
Ability to manage channel information by utilizing information management capabilities and incorporating other related information.
Ability to create and articulate a brand in a market.
Ability to assess and quantify the degree of familiarity and recognition a brand has within a market.
Ability to determine how well a brand is meeting objectives (i.e. creating the perception that is intended).
Ability to manage the relationship of brand with other business objects and/or utilize other capabilities in the management of brand.
Ability to conceptualize campaign objectives, themes, messages, and formats tailored to target audiences and business goals.
Ability to plan and launch campaigns by setting budgets, timelines, resources, and execution frameworks.
Ability to identify, segment, and prioritize target customer groups for campaign effectiveness and personalization.
Ability to determine the effectiveness of a campaign including how well a campaign is meeting specification and targets.
Ability to manage the relationship of a campaign with other business objects and/or utilize other capabilities in the management of campaigns.
Ability to plan, organize, and launch events (physical, digital, or hybrid) including budgeting, scheduling, and logistics.
Ability to identify and attract the right audience segments to maximize event participation, relevance, and business impact.
Ability to determine the effectiveness of an event including how well an event is meeting specification and targets.
Ability to manage the relationship of an event with other business objects and/or utilize other capabilities in the management of events.
Ability to manage (e.g. determine, establish, identify) the relationship of loyalty with a market.
Ability to set and determine the effectiveness of a loyalty program including how well a it is is meeting specification and targets.
Ability to manage the relationship of loyalty with other business objects and/or utilize other capabilities in the management of loyalty.
The ability to manage and monitor opportunity list(s). Includes monitoring pipeline and clean up of pipelines (hygene). Indentify and decide on stalled  and overdue opportunities.
Ability to track and assign leads across different lifecycle stages (e.g., new, contacted, qualified, converted, lost) for effective nurturing and conversion.
Ability to identify, quantify, qualify, and articulate a current or future market.
Ability to subdivide a market into unique, identifiable parts that may be targeted individually or in aggregate.
Ability to predict or estimate future demand or supply for a given period of time for a given market or market segment.
Ability to manage the relationship of a market with other business objects and/or utilize other capabilities in the management of markets.
Ability to draft and develop communication messages (marketing, service, compliance, or advisory) tailored for specific customer segments and objectives.
Ability to constrain the range of a message to, for example, a desired audience or market.
Ability to shape the intention and impact of a message, targeted to a specific audience.
Ability to manage the relationship of messages with other business objects and/or utilize other capabilities in the management of messages.
Ability to manage message risk by utilizing risk management capabilities and incorporating other related risks.
Ability to assess and validate offers against business rules, customer eligibility, regulatory requirements, and profitability criteria before launch.
Ability to design, configure, and package offers (products, bundles, discounts, rewards) that align with customer needs, market opportunities, and strategic goals.
Ability to project future sales performance using historical data, market trends, and customer insights to guide planning and strategy.
The ability forecast resourcing required and plan the application of resources to the forecast.
Ability to determine how well the business is meeting its intended sales objectives and tracking to its sales plan.
Ability to manage the relationship of sales with other business objects and/or utilize other capabilities in the management of sales.
Ability to design, test, and refine new financial products and services to meet evolving customer and market needs.
Ability to manage product variations and updates, ensuring availability, compliance, and alignment with business goals.
Ability to launch and distribute products across channels, ensuring readiness, integration, and effective market delivery.
Ability to define the rules, and constraints that limit a product or product features to specific customer groups.
Ability to determine how well a product is meeting specification and objective levels or delivering against plan.
Ability to set and maintain a current price list (with ranges and optional terms) by product/customer type, including standard and special (promotional) pricing.
Ability to manage the relationship of products with other business objects and/or utilize other capabilities in the management of products.
Ability to capture customer requests and required information to start the process of opening a new account.
Ability to validate customer details, complete documentation, and comply with regulatory checks to officially open an account.
Ability to activate deposit accounts, manage deposits and withdrawals, and ensure smooth account operation.
Ability to support ongoing maintenance of deposit accounts, including updates, issue resolution, and customer inquiries.
Ability to design loan terms, assess risk, and secure approvals based on credit policies and customer needs.
Ability to evaluate borrower creditworthiness, finalize agreements, and release funds as per loan terms.
Ability to complete loan documentation, register collateral, and perform checks after disbursement.
Ability to manage ongoing loan accounts, including repayments, adjustments, and customer support.

Ability to validate payment instructions, check compliance, and prepare transactions before execution.
Ability to capture and authorize customer payment requests across multiple channels.
Ability to execute and record payments, ensuring accuracy, speed, and security.
Ability to reconcile, transfer, and settle funds between banks or counterparties.
Ability to connect with domestic and international payment networks for seamless transaction flows.
Ability to handle exceptions, reversals, and adjustments after payment execution.
Ability to provide customer support, dispute resolution, and inquiry handling for payments.
Ability to oversee end-to-end payment operations, ensuring compliance, efficiency, and risk control.
Ability to issue, activate, and manage credit, debit, or prepaid cards, including replacements and upgrades.
Ability to validate and approve card transactions in real time, ensuring security and compliance with limits.
Ability to onboard and support merchants for card acceptance, settlement, and ongoing relationship management.
Ability to capture and process card transactions through acquiring systems for settlement.
Ability to reconcile, transfer, and settle funds between issuers, acquirers, and networks.
Ability to route card transactions securely between issuers, acquirers, and networks.
Ability to handle disputed transactions, chargebacks, and resolution processes with customers and merchants.
Ability to design, track, and manage card-based loyalty and rewards programs for customer engagement.
Ability to issue trade finance products such as letters of credit, guarantees, and bills of exchange to support international trade.
Ability to collect, validate, and manage trade documents including invoices, bills of lading, and customs records.
Ability to oversee the lifecycle of trade finance instruments, from issuance to settlement and closure.
Ability to verify trade details, counterparties, and documents to ensure compliance and reduce risk.

Ability to manage the relationship of trade finance with other business objects and/or utilize other capabilities in the management of trade finance.
Ability to register and capture details of collateral pledged against financial obligations.
Ability to assess and update the value of collateral to reflect current market conditions.
Ability to verify ownership, legal enforceability, and acceptability of pledged collateral.
Ability to manage the full lifecycle of collateral, including monitoring, substitution, release, and renewal.
Ability to manage the relationship of collateral with other business objects and/or utilize other capabilities in the management of collateral.
Ability to define and structure investment portfolios based on client objectives, asset classes, and risk appetite.
Ability to conduct research on an investment portfolio or an investment within a portfolio.
Ability to measure the performance of an investment portfolio including calculating ROR and other types of measurements.
Ability to assess and determine the monetary worth of an investment portfolio.
Ability to define the model/target allocation mix of investments to achieve the objectives as defined for the investment portfolio.
Ability to manage the relationship of investment portfolios with other business objects and/or utilize other capabilities in the management of investment portfolios.
Ability to define, track, and adjust financial goals such as education, retirement, or asset growth.
Ability to design financial strategies for estate transfer, inheritance, and long-term care needs.
Ability to optimize investment and financial plans by managing tax obligations and leveraging tax benefits.
Ability to monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of financial plans against defined objectives.
Ability to integrate and coordinate multiple financial plans, products, or accounts to achieve overall wealth objectives.
Ability to create and maintain reference data for financial instruments, including terms, conditions, and identifiers.
Ability to track holdings, exposures, and balances of financial instruments across portfolios.
Ability to determine and assign the monetary worth of a financial instrument, including mark-to-market and other valuation mechanisms at a point in time.
Ability to administer the correct allocation of entitlements to a customer arising from corporate actions of financial instruments.
Ability to hold financial instruments in safekeeping on behalf of a third party.
Ability to manage the relationship of financial instruments with other business objects and/or utilize other capabilities in the management of financial instruments.

Ability to establish, control, and monitor access rights to trust accounts and assets.

Ability to manage the relationship of trust with other business objects and/or utilize other capabilities in the management of trust.
Ability to create and define agreements, outlining scope, obligations, and responsibilities.
Ability to manage agreements across their lifecycle—from drafting, negotiation, execution, monitoring, to renewal/termination.
Ability to determine agreement balances in various ways (e.g. value date, posting date).
Ability to establish, modify, and interpret legally enforceable arrangements, provisions, requirements, rules and specifications of an agreement.
Ability to manage the relationship of agreements with other business objects and/or utilize other capabilities in the management of agreements.
Ability to define, interpret, and enforce the right to view, use, or modify an agreement.
Ability to manufacture, configure, and prepare customer devices/cards for issuance.
Ability to distribute and activate issued devices (e.g., cards, tokens, instruments) for customer use.
Ability to track, update, and manage the lifecycle status of issued devices (active, blocked, expired, replaced).
Ability to manage the relationship of issued devices with other business objects and/or utilize other capabilities in the management of issued devices.
Ability to define and maintain policies, rules, and procedures for applying interest rates and fees.
Ability to compute interest charges and fees accurately based on account terms, transactions, and regulatory guidelines.
Ability to define, monitor, and control credit, transaction, and exposure limits to manage financial risk and compliance.
Ability to design and establish liquidity management structures, including policies and account linkages.
Ability to monitor and optimize daily liquidity positions to ensure funds availability.
Ability to centralize funds from multiple accounts into a single account for better control and utilization.

Ability to automatically transfer funds between accounts to optimize interest, reduce debt, or meet funding needs.
Ability to create and manage virtual sub-accounts for tracking and reconciling client or business transactions.
Ability to predict future cash inflows and outflows to support liquidity and investment decisions.
Ability to provide real-time and periodic reporting on account balances and transaction activity.

Ability to match, verify, and reconcile transactions across accounts to ensure accuracy and resolve discrepancies.
Ability to handle, investigate, and resolve customer or counterparty disputes related to financial transactions and services.
Ability to purchase, lease or build a place, amenity, or item for a particular purpose.

Ability to effectively and efficiently manage the utilization of physical property.
Ability to preserve and improve the existing state (i.e. keep from failure or decline) of physical property.
Ability to manage the relationship of facilities and equipment with other business objects and/or utilize other capabilities in the management of facilities and equipment.
Ability to identify, evaluate, and onboard vendors and suppliers to meet business needs.

Ability to establish, control, predict, process, organize and purchase from an individual, or other legal entity, that the organization has, plans to have, or has an agreement with to supply goods and services.
Ability to manage the relationship of vendors and suppliers with other business objects and/or utilize other capabilities in the management of vendors and suppliers.
Ability to handle requisition requests, approvals, and purchase orders for goods and services.

Ability to group a set of tasks together for various purposes such as assignment or prioritization.
Ability to set a specific time when a task must start or be completed.
Ability to assign and present a task to a resource. (human or otherwise) such as partner, customer, vendor & supplier, or human resource.
Ability to set the importance or urgency of a task in relation to all other tasks.
Ability to attract, recruit, and onboard talent aligned with organizational needs.
Ability to manage salary, incentives, rewards and benefits of human capital.

Ability to discontinue the use and agreement with personnel.

Ability to set and determine measurable effectiveness targets of various types.

Ability to determine, formulate, establish, maintain, comply with, and administer principles, rules and guidelines for action of the organization.
Ability to assess and ensure adherence to internal policies, standards, and external regulations.
